Subject: Inditex-trained Brand Manager | Dubai-based for MENA expansion

I drove +30% GMV quarter-over-quarter managing 42 key fashion accounts at Alibaba's Miravia, building on my foundation in premium retail from Massimo Dutti and Inditex's visual merchandising standards.

With Gloria Jeans establishing its Dubai headquarters and expanding across MENA markets, I believe my Inditex retail playbook and deep UAE e-commerce network (Noon, Talabat, Careem) could accelerate your regional growth strategy.

I'm Dubai-based with residence visa and have successfully launched 6 NPD campaigns across 50+ countries, bringing both the operational discipline of Spanish fashion retail and the agility needed for emerging markets.

Would you have 15 minutes next week to discuss how my fashion retail background could support Gloria Jeans' MENA expansion? I'm particularly interested in your approach to premium positioning in this market.
Connecting as an Inditex-trained brand manager in Dubai. I've driven +30% GMV growth in fashion retail and have deep UAE e-commerce experience that could support Gloria Jeans' MENA expansion.

I'm reaching out as an Inditex-trained brand manager based in Dubai with a strong track record in fashion retail growth. I drove +30% GMV quarter-over-quarter managing 42 fashion accounts at Alibaba's Miravia, building on my Massimo Dutti foundation and Spanish retail discipline. With Gloria Jeans establishing its Dubai HQ for MENA expansion, I believe my retail playbook and UAE market expertise could be valuable. Would you be open to a brief conversation about your regional growth plans?
